requirements.requirement: Configure node1's host firewall to rate-limit repeated new SSH connections.
requirements.summary: Persistent IPv4 and IPv6 rules match new TCP/22 SYN traffic per source. After reboot, direct IPv4 testing accepted attempts 1–7 and dropped attempts 8–9, with drop counters and tracked-source state confirming firewall enforcement. The rules also survived a firewalld reload and node restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep normal administrative SSH access available while limiting repeated attempts.
requirements.summary: SSHD remained active and listening on IPv4 and IPv6; permitted attempts received OpenSSH banners. After the isolated source was limited, a distinct administrative source still received an SSH banner, and final service health remained good.

overall_summary: The task outcomes are satisfied. Repeated new SSH connections were demonstrably limited while ordinary SSH reachability remained available. The provider restart protocol was complete for node1: it captured a healthy pre-restart state, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered services and firewall state; fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the transition.
limitations: Rate-limiting behavior was directly exercised over IPv4 only; IPv6 coverage is supported by mirrored installed and recovered rules but was not behaviorally tested.
Administrative availability was demonstrated through SSH banners, listeners, and service health rather than a completed authenticated login.
The behavioral source was an isolated non-loopback network namespace on node1, not a separate physical or managed host.

operational_hygiene.summary: Firewall changes, reload, reboot, and isolated network fixtures all had clear implementation or verification roles. The fixtures were removed; the initially incomplete cleanup was corrected and final absence verified. No failed services, package damage, or unwanted listeners remained. The sole hygiene defect was the diagnostic extract /tmp/firewalld-rich.txt, created by cmd-5554bab8d7e543e9 and left behind after completion. No other unnecessary mutation is evident.
